scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const srcData = path.join('src', 'data'); const distData = path.join('dist', 'data'); if (fs.existsSync(srcData)) { fs.mkdirSync(distData, { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync(srcData).forEach(file => fs.copyFileSync(path.join(srcData, file), path.join(distData, file))); console.log('✓ Copied data files to dist'); }"
